content.short: Ethereum Follow Protocol (EFP) provides an onchain social graph for Ethereum accounts, complementing ENS, SIWE, and the Ethereum identity stack.
content.description: Ethereum Follow Protocol (EFP) enables onchain following of Ethereum accounts, creating a dedicated social layer for the network. Profiles become sovereign onchain identities—immutable and censorship-resistant. EFP presents a transparent view of DeFi positions, NFT purchases, and trades from followed accounts, adding context and social visibility to onchain activity. By weaving social interaction directly into the Ethereum identity stack, EFP expands how users connect, discover, and engage with onchain ecosystems.

resources.tldr: Costs, tags, and the deliberate scope limits: no names, no login, no posting. What EFP refuses to do is half the design.
